description: Commit 6ec47b4 swept the method API to take typed &Id and &State instead of &str. This makes empty-Id construction impossible by typing alone (PLAN.md:108-112), reducing the runtime-check surface vs. the kith reference impl. The Patch<T> machinery (mod.rs:124-187) extends this discipline to partial updates with Patch::Keep / Patch::Set / Patch::Clear states the wire format can express. A future contributor might suggest 'simplifying' by collapsing Patch<T> into Option<Option<T>> — DO NOT accept that change. The three-state Patch is what makes 'no change' vs 'set' vs 'clear' distinguishable at the type level; Option<Option<T>> looks the same but has confusing semantics and no Deserialize discipline. Worth defending in a public comment thread.
title: DECISION: typed Id/State params + Patch<T> machinery makes invalid state unrepresentable
